content:
ada: Heads-up — I'm seeing a p99 regression on the canary after the fastpath batching tweak. tagging runtime folks.

kai: what are the numbers?

ada: baseline (prod v2.16): p50 12ms, p95 88ms, p99 180ms
ada: canary (v2.17-hotfix): p50 13ms, p95 132ms, p99 345ms

morgan: wow, p99 doubled. KV hit rate?

ada: kv_hit: prod 98% -> canary 95%. avg batch size went 4 -> 6 after tweak.

henry: could be batching policy + kernel selection change. did the quant/kernel matrix change?

ada: using same quant profile `quant-opt:v2`. kernel logs look like this:
```
[kernel] selected: fast-attn-x8
[alloc] gpu mem +200MB peak
[batch] avg=6 median=5
```

lina: can you run a focused bisect: revert batching tweak only, keep everything else? that should tell us if batching is culprit.

morgan: I'll queue that run now. command I used:
`./bench --model v2.17-hotfix --seq 32 --qps 200 --runs 5 --tag canary-bisect`

oncall-bot: Benchmark job queued: job/48291 — expected duration ~12m. https://ci/48291

kai: if bisect shows p99 back to ~180-220ms, we rollback batching tweak. otherwise we need deeper kernel/allocation profiling.

ada: agreed. tentative decision flow:
- bisect run -> if p99 < 220ms -> mark canary green and proceed
- else -> rollback and open hotfix branch + perf issue ticket

morgan: I'm +1 to rollback if no fix within 4h after results. who's owning rollback?

henry: I'll own rollback and promotion back to v2.16 config. I'll be oncall for the window.

ada: thanks. I'll post results when job/48291 finishes.

lina: FYI I'll also attach perf traces from the profiler after the bisect run. could be useful for root cause.

morgan: thanks all. will wait for the job link. :eyes:

ada: result posted: job/48291 shows p99 190ms (bisect run with batching reverted). logging summary:
- p50 12ms p95 89ms p99 190ms
- kv_hit 98%

ada: conclusion: batching tweak introduced the regression. recommend rollback of that change from release branch.

morgan: roll? (vote)

kai: +1 rollback. ops & product notified.

henry: starting rollback now, will update CI/PR and kick new canary without batching change.

oncall-bot: Deploy rollback started: deploy/rollback-2171234567 — ETA 8m.

ada: once rollback completes, run quick smoke: `./smoke --model v2.16 --quick` and confirm p99.

henry: rollback complete. quick smoke shows p99 182ms. marking canary cleared.

morgan: great work. will file a follow-up to make batching change opt-in behind perf-safe flag and add perf gate to PR.

ada: filing ticket now. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
